free_tier.stated: Free/Standard account: 10 uploads per 24h, no document-count or storage figure published; Pro is "Unlimited Documents" for $19/month (3-day trial). Home page now flags free uploads as "Restricted Demo Mode". Only you can view them.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 60 requests/min; 10 uploads/24h standard (1,000/24h Pro); documents deleted after 60 days without views (third-party report); free sharing disabled.

egress.terms: Free tier cannot publish a public link at all: "Restricted Demo Mode. Only you can view your uploaded documents. To share documents with others, your need a Pro subscription." Pro is metered by subscription, not by GB.

tooling: Real REST API (OpenAPI 3.0, v1.2.0) at https://www.docdroid.com/api with OAuth2 or personal access tokens: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /document, webhooks, analytics. No rclone backend.
chaining: Weak: 10 uploads/day x unlimited free accounts, but free documents are invisible to anyone else, so it only works as private storage and is capped by the 24h upload rate, not by bytes.
limits_note: 60 requests/min; 10 uploads/24h standard (1,000/24h Pro); documents deleted after 60 days without views (third-party report); free sharing disabled.
